historical_artifact_hash_comparison.limits: One surviving legacy-only artifact is comparable by exact hash. The main #735 receipt did not retain raster hashes for the other observations or any paired original set.

visual_inspections.observation: Both new renders show the same dense matrix grid and readable page-level layout. PDFium text and rules are visibly heavier. No gross grid displacement or outer-page clipping is visible at this inspection scale.
visual_inspections.limits: No cell-by-cell transcription or cell topology evaluation was performed; no renderer-correctness or harmlessness conclusion follows.

visual_inspections.observation: Both new renders show the same cover-sheet composition and map frame. The PDFium view makes faint heading/body text and several hairlines visibly darker/more distinct.
visual_inspections.limits: No independent authored-ink labeling was performed; unmatched ink is not assigned as a loss/error by either engine.

visual_inspections.observation: Both processed agreement images contain mostly sparse letter/line fragments, including scan-edge strokes. The line-fragment shapes differ. The two full manifests retain their distinct applied deskew transforms.
visual_inspections.limits: This line-morphology profile is not a transcription image. The views do not establish which text/rules were correctly retained or whether near-edge source ink was clipped.

qualification_status: unqualified: all35 still exceed original tolerances; representative visual observations and exact metric replay do not prove all outliers harmless
